summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py, tests/test_progress.py, and CHANGELOG.md. Changes: TaskProgressColumn gained a show_speed option (default False) and a classmethod render_speed that scales speed via filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix and returns "X.Y<suffix> it/s" text (empty text for None); render() returns speed text when the total is unknown and show_speed is on, using finished_speed or speed. The track() helper gained show_speed (default True) and passes it to the column. Progress.track now infers an Optional total (explicit, else len for Sized, else None) and no longer raises for unsized iterables. Tests: added test_task_progress_column_speed and removed the ValueError assertions from test_track and test_progress_track. CHANGELOG has one Added line. Not run: tests, mypy, or any repository code, per instructions. Nothing committed.
